name: expo
summary: Expo/React Native structure with app routes, features, native-ready components, services, models, design system, and tests.
dependency_direction: app routes -> src/features -> src/components/design-system -> src/services -> src/models.

folders.responsibility: Expo Router routes, layouts, and navigation entry points.

folders.allowed: Feature UI, state, hooks, local components.
folders.avoid: Global service clients and unrelated shared UI.

folders.responsibility: Tokens, themes, platform UI rules, and component policy.
API clients, storage, native service adapters.
folders.allowed: Network, secure storage wrappers, and analytics adapters already in scope and authorized.

folders.responsibility: Shared types, schemas, and domain models.

rules: Follow the project's existing Expo/React Native structure, components, navigation, and design system; for greenfield choices, prefer well-supported platform primitives that meet the product requirement.
Respect the project's routing conventions; use Expo Router conventions when Expo Router is the selected router.
Use platform-adaptive behavior via Platform.OS checks when needed.
Preserve existing typography. For new choices, prefer accessible platform-supported fonts unless the product requires a custom family.
Keep native service adapters out of UI components.
Do not install or replace a UI component kit without explicit authorization and a demonstrated need.
When visual direction is incomplete, preserve existing tokens or propose a coherent option and label assumptions; do not force a separate baseline-then-design phase.
Use an exposed Expo-specific Skill when deployment, native modules, or data fetching needs current domain guidance.
validation: Inspect package scripts before running checks.
Use Expo run actions or simulator/device verification when behavior is native-specific.
